cut.note: Laser processing type: cut fully through the material (red lines). Appears in the export panel, layer legend, and Studio hand-off. Use the label xTool Studio uses for its Cut processing type; noun or infinitive per the platform's convention.

score.note: Laser processing type: a shallow vector line burned along a path without cutting through (blue lines; contour lines, alignment marks). NOT a score/points/rating. Distinct from Engrave (raster fill). Match xTool Studio's Score label where one exists.

engrave.note: Laser processing type: marking the surface without cutting through (labels, text, flat engravings). Appears in the export panel and layer legend.

fillEngrave.note: Engraving that fills a closed shape with raster passes (water areas, public-land tints), as opposed to scoring its outline. Export panel and Studio processing settings.
fillEngrave.th: แกะสลักแบบเติม

kerf.note: Width of material the laser beam removes when cutting; TopoStack offsets cut paths by it so pieces fit. Machine/material settings. Many communities keep the English word; a local technical term is fine if short.
kerf.th: ความกว้างรอยตัด

processingType.note: Setting that says whether a line is cut, scored, or engraved; mirrors the xTool Studio field of the same purpose. Export panel.
processingType.th: ประเภทการประมวลผล

redLineCut.note: Legend entry in the preview and export: red strokes are cut lines. Keep the colour word and the operation word.
redLineCut.th: เส้นสีแดง (ตัด)

blueLineScore.note: Legend entry in the preview and export: blue strokes are scored or engraved, not cut. Reuse the Score and Engrave terms.
blueLineScore.th: เส้นสีน้ำเงิน (ขีดเส้น/แกะสลัก)

material.note: The stock being cut (plywood, MDF, acrylic, cardboard). Material picker in the settings rail and export.

materialThickness.note: Thickness of one sheet; sets the height of each layer. Settings rail, shown with mm or in.
materialThickness.th: ความหนาวัสดุ

sheet.note: One physical stock sheet (board, panel of plywood, acrylic plate) that pieces are nested onto. Also "stock sheet". Sheet count, sheet size, export per sheet. Not a spreadsheet or a UI sheet/drawer.

sheetSize.note: Width and height of the stock sheet (often the machine's work area). Settings rail.

nesting.note: Arranging the cut pieces on sheets to use as little material as possible. Export panel and sheet preview. Use the word your laser/CNC community uses (xTool calls it layout / 排版 in Chinese).
nesting.th: การจัดวางชิ้นงาน

automaticLayout.note: Button/option that nests pieces automatically. Keep consistent with Nesting.
automaticLayout.th: จัดวางอัตโนมัติ

piece.note: One separate cut part (a layer may yield several pieces). Also "part". Piece counts, assembly labels, nesting messages.

panel.note: A section of the studio's settings rail (Terrain, Water, Labels...). UI panel, NOT a wood panel/sheet of material. Keep distinct from Sheet.

masterSvg.note: The single combined SVG with every layer and operation, as opposed to per-sheet files. Export panel. Keep "SVG" untranslated.

openInStudio.note: Primary export button: hands the design to xTool Studio. "Studio" is the product name (xTool Studio) and stays in English.

download.note: Button: save the exported files to the computer.

export.note: Panel title and verb for producing the SVG files. Use the verb form on buttons, noun form on headings if the language distinguishes them.

layer.note: One physical sheet-thickness slice of the relief, between two contour elevations. NOT a software/drawing layer (in German avoid "Ebene"; in Japanese/Korean prefer the physical word). Layer count, layer list, legend.

layeredRelief.note: Output mode: a 3D model built from stacked cut layers. Mode switch in the settings rail; opposite of Flat engraving.
layeredRelief.th: ภาพนูนแบบซ้อนชั้น

flatEngraving.note: Output mode: a single sheet with the map engraved/scored on it, no stacking. Mode switch in the settings rail.
flatEngraving.th: แกะสลักแบบเรียบ

stack.note: The full set of layers glued on top of each other; also the stack plan. Stack height, stack preview.
stack.th: ชุดชั้นซ้อน

explodedView.note: 3D preview option that separates the layers vertically so each is visible. Preview toolbar.
explodedView.th: มุมมองแยกชั้น

verticalExaggeration.note: Multiplier on elevation so flat terrain shows relief (e.g. 2x). Terrain panel. Use the cartography/GIS term.
verticalExaggeration.th: การขยายแนวดิ่ง

contourLine.note: Line of equal elevation; each layer edge is one. Terrain panel, legend. Use the cartographic term.
contourLine.th: เส้นชั้นความสูง

indexContour.note: Every Nth contour, drawn heavier (often labelled with its elevation). Contour styling options.
indexContour.th: เส้นชั้นความสูงหลัก

contourInterval.note: Elevation difference between adjacent contour lines/layers. Terrain panel.
contourInterval.th: ช่วงชั้นความสูง

alignmentMarks.note: Small scored marks on each layer showing where the layer above sits, used while gluing. Assembly options.
alignmentMarks.th: เครื่องหมายจัดแนว

assemblyLabel.note: Small engraved ID (e.g. "L3-2") on each piece telling the maker its layer and order; also "assembly id". Placed under the glue area so it is hidden after assembly.
assemblyLabel.th: ป้ายประกอบ

glueArea.note: Part of a layer covered by the layer above, where glue goes and hidden marks may be placed. Assembly options, warnings.
glueArea.th: พื้นที่ทากาว

minimumFeature.note: Smallest piece or gap width the laser and material can produce reliably; smaller slivers are removed. Cleanup settings and warnings.
minimumFeature.th: ขนาดเล็กสุดที่ตัดได้

baseLayer.note: The bottom full sheet the stack is glued onto. Layer list, stack settings.

elevation.note: Height above sea level of the terrain. Terrain panel, legend, labels.
elevation.th: ระดับความสูง

terrain.note: The land surface being modelled; also the Terrain panel title.
terrain.th: ภูมิประเทศ

mapScale.note: Map/model scale (e.g. 1:50,000), not the Scale bar graphic. Settings rail, plan summary.

preview.note: The 2D/3D preview of the model in the studio.

generate.note: Button/status: compute the model from the chosen area and settings.

label.note: Text engraved on the model (place names, elevations, title). Labels panel. Not a form field label.

frame.note: Border cut around the model or engraving. Frame options.

attribution.note: Required credit line for map/elevation data sources, engraved or shown in the UI. Keep data source names in English.
attribution.th: การระบุแหล่งที่มา

machine.note: The user's laser cutter/engraver (machine profile, work area). Settings and export.

plywood.note: Material preset; the most common stock for layered reliefs (often basswood/birch). Material picker.

lake.note: Water body; lakes can get depth layers and acrylic inserts. Water panel, labels.

river.note: Flowing water feature drawn or engraved on the map. Water panel.

waterDepth.note: Depth below the water surface (lake bed shape). Water panel; layers can step down into the lake.
waterDepth.th: ความลึกของน้ำ

bathymetry.note: Underwater terrain data (lake or sea floor). Data source notes, water panel.
bathymetry.th: ความลึกท้องน้ำ

shoreline.note: Edge where water meets land (lakes, rivers, coast). Water panel, cut paths.
shoreline.th: แนวชายฝั่ง

acrylic.note: Clear or tinted acrylic (PMMA) sheet, used for water and airspace. Material picker. Use the everyday maker word (Vietnamese makers say "mica").

acrylicWaterInsert.note: Acrylic piece cut to the lake outline that sits in the relief as the water surface. Water panel, export sheet list.
acrylicWaterInsert.th: ชิ้นน้ำอะคริลิค

fitClearance.note: Small gap left around an insert so it drops into its opening. Water/acrylic settings, in mm or in.
fitClearance.th: ระยะเผื่อสวม

ledge.note: Narrow shelf in the layer below that the acrylic insert rests on. Water/acrylic settings.

paintTemplate.note: Cut-out stencil used to spray or brush paint onto water or public-land areas. Also "stencil". Export options.

surveyedDepth.note: Lake depth from a real measured survey (NOAA, USGS, chart trace). Water panel badge; contrast with Modeled depth.
surveyedDepth.th: ความลึกจากการสำรวจ

modeledDepth.note: Lake depth estimated by a model (GLOBathy), not measured; less precise. Water panel badge.
modeledDepth.th: ความลึกจากแบบจำลอง

road.note: Map feature from OpenStreetMap. Features panel.

trail.note: Hiking/footpath feature from OpenStreetMap. Features panel. Not a GPX track (that is Path).
trail.th: เส้นทางเดินป่า

transportationLabels.note: Engraved names/numbers of roads, trails, and rail lines. Labels panel.
transportationLabels.th: ป้ายชื่อเส้นทาง

stateBoundaries.note: Administrative boundary lines (US states, Canadian provinces). Features panel.
stateBoundaries.th: เขตแดนรัฐ/จังหวัด

latLongGrid.note: Graticule lines engraved on the map. Map decorations.
latLongGrid.th: ตารางละติจูด/ลองจิจูด

northArrow.note: Simple arrow pointing north. Map decorations; distinct from Compass (rose).
northArrow.th: ลูกศรทิศเหนือ

compass.note: Decorative compass rose with cardinal directions. Map decorations; distinct from North arrow.

scaleBar.note: Graphic bar showing distance on the map. Map decorations; distinct from map Scale.
scaleBar.th: แถบมาตราส่วน

legend.note: Key explaining symbols/colours, on the preview or engraved. Map decorations, aviation.
legend.th: คำอธิบายสัญลักษณ์

marker.note: A user-placed point (pin) on the map, engraved as a symbol. Custom data panel.

path.note: A user-drawn or imported (GPX/KML/GeoJSON) route line on the map, e.g. a hike taken. Custom data panel. NOT a vector path in the laser software sense.

publicLand.note: Government-managed land from PAD-US/Canadian data, engraved or stencilled. Public lands panel; US context.
publicLand.th: ที่ดินสาธารณะ

nationalPark.note: Public land category. Public lands legend.
nationalPark.th: อุทยานแห่งชาติ

nationalForest.note: US Forest Service land category. Public lands legend.
nationalForest.th: ป่าสงวนแห่งชาติ

nationalMonument.note: US protected-area category (can be a large landscape, not only a statue). Public lands legend.
nationalMonument.th: อนุสรณ์สถานแห่งชาติ

wilderness.note: US designated wilderness area (strictest protection). Public lands legend.
wilderness.th: พื้นที่ธรรมชาติดั้งเดิม

blmLand.note: Land managed by the US Bureau of Land Management. Keep "BLM" as the acronym.

wildlifeRefuge.note: US National Wildlife Refuge category. Public lands legend; keep distinct from Preserve.
wildlifeRefuge.th: เขตรักษาพันธุ์สัตว์ป่า

statePark.note: Park managed by a US state or Canadian province. Public lands legend.
statePark.th: อุทยานของรัฐ

preserve.note: Nature preserve/reserve (government or conservation group). Public lands legend.
preserve.th: เขตอนุรักษ์

tribalLand.note: Lands of Native American / First Nations tribes (reservations, trust land). Use the respectful current term in each language; avoid dated or pejorative words.
tribalLand.th: ดินแดนชนเผ่า

militaryLand.note: Land held by the armed forces. Public lands legend.
militaryLand.th: พื้นที่ทหาร

airspace.note: US FAA airspace shown decoratively (engraved or as acrylic forms). Aviation panel. Always pair with "Not for navigation".

classBAirspace.note: ICAO/FAA airspace class. Keep the Latin letter "B" untranslated (pilots in every target language use it); translate only "airspace"/"class". Aviation panel and legend.
classBAirspace.th: ห้วงอากาศชั้น B

classCAirspace.note: ICAO/FAA airspace class; keep the letter "C". Same pattern as Class B.
classCAirspace.th: ห้วงอากาศชั้น C

classDAirspace.note: ICAO/FAA airspace class; keep the letter "D". Same pattern as Class B. Optional layer.
classDAirspace.th: ห้วงอากาศชั้น D

specialUseAirspace.note: FAA category (SUA) grouping MOAs, restricted, prohibited and warning areas. Aviation panel.
specialUseAirspace.th: ห้วงอากาศใช้งานพิเศษ
specialUseAirspace.vi: Vùng trời sử dụng đặc biệt

moa.note: Military Operations Area, an FAA special-use airspace type. Keep the acronym "MOA" in every language; expand in a tooltip if needed (e.g. zh 军事行动区).

restrictedArea.note: FAA special-use airspace type (R-xxxx). Use the ICAO term pilots know in each language.

airport.note: Aviation feature; engraved symbol and label. Aviation panel.

runway.note: Engraved runway outline at airports. Aviation panel.

navaid.note: Radio navigation aid (VOR, NDB, etc.) shown as a symbol. Aviation panel.
navaid.th: เครื่องช่วยเดินอากาศ

obstacle.note: Tall structure from the FAA obstacle file (towers, antennas). Aviation panel.
obstacle.th: สิ่งกีดขวาง

vfrSectional.note: FAA VFR aeronautical chart series; TopoStack can style engravings like it. Keep "VFR"; "sectional" may stay English where pilots use it.
vfrSectional.ja: VFRセクショナルチャート
vfrSectional.th: แผนที่การบิน VFR

ceiling.note: Upper altitude limit of an airspace volume (e.g. 10,000 ft MSL). Aviation panel. Not a weather cloud ceiling, not a room ceiling.
ceiling.th: ระดับสูงสุด

floor.note: Lower altitude limit of an airspace volume. Pair with Ceiling. Aviation panel.
floor.th: ระดับต่ำสุด

rod.note: Acrylic or dowel support rod holding raised airspace layers above the terrain. Aviation acrylic settings. Physical part, not a unit of length.

airspaceLevel.note: One altitude tier of the acrylic airspace model (each tier a sheet at a given height). Aviation panel. Not a flight level (FL) and not a terrain Layer.

notForNavigation.note: Mandatory disclaimer on aviation output and the aviation panel. Keep it unambiguous; a clear imperative is fine.
notForNavigation.fr: Ne pas utiliser pour la navigation
notForNavigation.th: ห้ามใช้เพื่อการนำทาง

mapArea.note: The rectangle of the world the model covers. Map panel, plan summary.
mapArea.th: พื้นที่แผนที่

location.note: The place the model is centred on. Place panel, search.

chooseLocation.note: Button/heading that opens place search. Imperative.
chooseLocation.th: เลือกสถานที่

suggestedPlaces.note: List of example locations offered before the user searches. Place panel.
suggestedPlaces.th: สถานที่แนะนำ

undo.note: Toolbar button / shortcut. Use the platform-standard word.

redo.note: Toolbar button / shortcut. Use the platform-standard word.

tips.note: Heading for helpful hints in the studio.

metric.note: Units option (mm, m). Settings. Adjective for the unit system.

imperial.note: Units option (inches, feet). Settings. Adjective for the unit system.
imperial.th: อิมพีเรียล
